Class UDFFillService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.udffill.UDFFillService
@Service public class UDFFillService extends Object
Runs, tests and summarises the automatic filling of user-defined security fields, and carries out the cell actions of the user. Every write goes through UDFFillWriter; the outcome of a source is always computed outside a transaction.

  • Method Details

    • runField

      public void runField(Integer idUDFMetadata)
      One fill run for one field, the work of the task UDF_FILL_VALUES with a field as entity. Every due cell of the tenant scope is computed and written in its own transaction; afterwards the fill rows of securities that left the scope are removed. Between two securities an interruption ends the run, and the next run continues with the cells still due.
      Parameters:
      idUDFMetadata - the field
      Throws:
      TaskInterruptException - when the run was interrupted, for instance by its timeout

    • unlockCell

      public void unlockCell(Integer idUDFMetadata, Integer idSecurity, User user)
      The cell action "Fill automatically again": deletes the lock and, for a template, evaluates the cell at once. A resolver makes HTTP requests, which never run on a request thread; its field gets a fill run instead.
      Parameters:
      idUDFMetadata - the field of the caller
      idSecurity - a security of the tenant scope
      user - the caller

    • fillWatchlistTemplates

      public void fillWatchlistTemplates(User user, List<Security> securities, Supplier<Map<Integer, Map<String,Object>>> valuesSupplier)
      Fills the template fields of the user for the securities of a watchlist, synchronously while the watchlist is loaded. Only in the home tenant of the user with write access; the fill rows and the Yahoo symbols are loaded once for the whole watchlist, and a write transaction is opened only for a cell whose decision changes something.
      Parameters:
      user - the user who loads the watchlist
      securities - the securities of the watchlist
      valuesSupplier - reads per security the current values of the user; called only when the user has a template field
